copy.en:
Dry-Wet Separation, Ready to Travel
Keep damp clothing separate from dry packing throughout changing travel days
Four side hooks hold additional bags
Top metal hook keeps essentials accessible
copy.zh:
干湿分离，出行更从容
干衣与湿衣分开收纳，适应旅途中衣物变化
侧面四个挂钩，可悬挂多个袋子
顶部金属挂钩，方便取用物品
copy.de:
Trocken und Nass getrennt packen

Vier seitliche Haken halten zusätzliche Taschen
Oberer Metallhaken hält Wichtiges griffbereit
copy.fr:

Crochet métallique supérieur pour garder l’essentiel accessible
copy.it:

Quattro ganci laterali per appendere borse
Gancio metallico superiore per avere l’essenziale a portata
copy.es:
Separa lo seco y lo húmedo

Gancho metálico superior para tener lo esencial a mano

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为干湿分离袋帮助出行时分开收纳湿衣与干衣，事实依据为产品资料中的“干湿分离袋，保障出行时干湿衣物分离”；辅助证据为侧面4个挂钩及顶部1个金属挂钩。PC画布为1464×600：左侧文案区严格使用[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，右侧产品区使用[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]。PC阅读顺序从左上至左下为标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2，随后观看右侧打开的箱体与局部细节。标题突出干湿分离；支持说明解释干衣与湿衣分开收纳；细节1对应侧面四个挂钩；细节2对应顶部金属挂钩。右侧以三分之二打开的YWJ 13A旅行箱为主体，清楚展示涤纶内衬中的干湿分离袋，并摆放干衣、湿衣两组服装作为使用示意；箱体旁展示少量可悬挂袋子。将箱体表面竖条纹纹路安排为近景特写，将铝合金框架与铰链安排为局部结构特写，以回应定制方向并体现外观与结构设计；不得把这些视觉元素延伸为未经证实的性能承诺。移动端画布为1200×900：产品区位于上方[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，文案区位于底部[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]；移动阅读顺序为先看上方打开的箱体、干湿分离袋、竖条纹和框架铰链细节，再按标题、支持说明、两个证据细节阅读。采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色、自然光和清晰边缘，避免过度反光。使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题加粗，正文高对比易读，数字清晰，并为德语文本预留约20%横向扩展空间。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的干湿分离袋、干湿衣物分开收纳、侧面4个挂钩、顶部1个金属挂钩、竖条纹表面、铝合金框架与铰链开合等事实；不宣称防水、密封、防盗、测试、认证、绝对耐用、静音或官方背书。画面不得出现竞品商标、虚构评分、促销角标或未经证实的尺寸、容量与性能信息。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ full-image composition for the YWJ 13A travel suitcase, with NO rendered text, letters, logos, labels, badges, or watermarks. Use a European modern travel photography style, low-saturation neutral colors, natural daylight, crisp product edges, and controlled reflections. PC canvas: 1464x600. Place the open suitcase on the right in [0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84], opened approximately two-thirds. Show the polyester interior with a clearly visible dry-wet separation bag, with separate dry and damp clothing arranged as a realistic packing scene. Show side-mounted four hooks holding several small bags and the single top metal hook holding one essential item. Add a close-up visual inset or naturally composed macro detail of the vertical surface stripes, plus a separate close-up of the aluminium frame and hinge opening mechanism. Keep the left area [0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8] clean, calm, and completely free for later copy placement. PC visual order: product and functional proof on the right, copy area reserved on the left. Mobile canvas: 1200x900; place the product and functional scene in the upper region [0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53], leaving the lower region [0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31] uncluttered for copy. On mobile, prioritize the opened suitcase and dry-wet bag first, with stripe and frame-hinge details still visible, followed by the reserved lower copy area. Do not add any unverified waterproof, sealed, tested, certified, anti-theft, silent, or absolute durability cues.
